description: A scope drawn across the whole panel, plotting one input against the other

params.text: Multiplies the X input before it is drawn
Moves the trace left and right
Multiplies the Y input before it is drawn
Moves the trace up and down
Sets how long a stretch of signal is drawn at once
Turns the whole trace about its centre

inputs.text: The signal drawn left to right, or the upper trace with lissajous mode turned off
The signal drawn top to bottom, or the lower trace with lissajous mode turned off
Sets the colour the trace is drawn in
Sets how long a stretch of signal is drawn at once, in place of the speed knob
Turns the whole trace about its centre, in place of the rotation knob

notes: the right-hand edge of the module can be dragged to make it wider
menu: Lissajous Mode — draws one input against the other; with it off the two inputs are drawn as separate traces against time
